title: Waking Up & The Blizzard Fortress (A CVICU Romance)
summary: Waking after extubation in the Star City General CVICU with a claustrophobic CPAP mask strapped to his face, Jordan spirals into a sensory panic until Aubrie Jean and Madison intervene and the nurse switches him to a high-flow nasal cannula. The next afternoon, an early lecture cancellation allows Zoë to catch the 1:15 PM RVT Roanoke Express bus to the hospital minutes before an unseasonable mountain blizzard shuts down Interstate 81—stranding Zoë as Jordan's sole overnight guardian. As snow howls outside, Zoë guides Jordan through his incentive spirometer exercises, celebrates his liberation from NPO status, shares their first romantic kiss under Protocol: Intimacy.v2, and uses pure logic to help him overcome an eighteen-year trauma deadlock before Daniel brings him home to Christiansburg.
